lesson.menu_title: Negotiating Next Steps -- Conditions and Proposals
lesson.menu_desc: Negotiate the next steps of a GI partnership with a consortium in Parma, with 'if' for conditions and polite phrases like 'Would it be possible to...?' -- 36 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 23 -- Negotiating Next Steps
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Flávia Florêncio Ferreira | Lesson 23 -- Negotiating Next Steps
lesson.grammar_point: zero and first conditional (if + present, will / can + verb)

listenings.text: Hello, Flavia. This is Paolo Ricci, from the consortium in Parma. Thank you for the meeting today. I talked to our board, and they like the proposal. But we have two questions. First, if we confirm the dates, can two of our experts visit Sao Paulo in April? Second, if they visit, can they see the coffee producers? Our members are very interested in coffee. Please send me a short summary of our agreement before Friday. If that works for you, we can talk again on Tuesday. Thank you, and see you soon.

Here are three simple tips for a negotiation. First, start with the mutual benefit. Say what both sides get from the agreement. Second, use if to set your conditions. Do not say: we need the documents. Say: if you send the documents, we can start next month. It is clear, and it is polite. Third, never end a meeting without a next step. Before you say goodbye, agree on one clear action, a name, and a date. A meeting without a next step is only a conversation.

extra_audio.text: First, I present our proposal and the mutual benefit for both sides. Then, I set one condition: if you confirm this week, we will organize the visit. Next, I listen to the partner and I offer a compromise on the date. After that, I accept the terms politely: we would be happy to do that. Finally, I agree on the next step and I say: if that works for you.

items.situation: A partner asks: "What are the next steps?" Answer with one condition.
You want to meet the partner next week. Ask politely.
The partner wants the documents in Italian. Accept the condition.
The partner says your date is difficult. Offer a compromise.
Close the meeting with the next step.
tips: I can send a summary today.
